sources.reason: No authorized open or author-hosted full text found; SIAM PDF was inaccessible.

term_search.limitation: Term absence is supporting negative evidence only; it is not proof that no equivalent classification is expressed using other language. The theorem and proof sections were also read directly.

T-01.basis: Both papers define f=h(G) and cite the necessary-and-sufficient disjoint-image/fiber criterion as prior work.

T-11.basis: Both papers construct the same two-copy bad-fiber CNF in linear time and use SAT to witness nonfactorization. Neither inspected text states NP-completeness of bad-fiber existence or coNP-completeness of factorization.

falsifiers: A source predating or independent of this review explicitly classifies the unrestricted Boolean-circuit bad-fiber problem as NP-complete or the corresponding dependency problem as coNP-complete.
Karp 1963 or another inaccessible foundational source contains an equivalent complexity classification.
T-11 imposes restrictions under which the two-copy SAT encoding is not polynomial-size or the decision problem changes complexity.
decision: Do not claim novelty for T-01 or for T-11's witness construction. Preserve only the explicit unrestricted complexity classification as a residual candidate pending a focused complexity-literature search and inspection of foundational sources.
